eyebrow: What makes the pillars work together
code:
# Three cross-cutting capabilities (span ALL five pillars):
#
# Visibility & Analytics
#   - can you see and correlate signals across pillars?
#
# Automation & Orchestration
#   - do risk signals trigger automated responses?
#
# Governance
#   - do policy + accountability structures make controls durable?
#
# A pillar can look advanced technically and still fail here.
caption: A great segmentation setup with no governance process isn't mature — it's fragile.
